capabilities: Render checkbox and radio button lists from frontmatterinput YAML code blocks
Write selected tag paths to frontmatter and remove them on deselect
Show nested child lists only when their parent tag is selected
Prevent duplicate tags and clean up child tags with the parent
Embed lists in note templates for consistent tagging
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community plugin list; the README recommends installing via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases while review is pending.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to set frontmatter tags by clicking; users must type nested tag paths manually and remember to clean up child tags.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT from Community Plugins if you haven't already

summary: Interactive checkbox and radio button lists, defined in YAML code blocks, that add or remove nested tags in a note's frontmatter.
